content: Kǝsghaakakǝsǝg Daadamazhigǝl kǝ Israila
Ən taa ba jiir nai ma Kǝristi, fiid bi wan tag nai biya. Ma tǝ dzamaghǝrar ǝn sǝrgasǝrǝg ba pakkat tǝdvad tagaana Shǝɗkwa Daadamazhigǝl tǝghǝr kwannǝn taakiya
ǝn dǝ badzǝga ǝrviɗmahuɗ ba vaivaiya, dlaɓa mbakwambǝg ma ǝrviɗmahuɗara.
Ambana ma naa ba tlafatlafana, dlaɓa tagwkwi nǝ uud dǝ Kǝristi mbakyarvad zaraabahara, uudahar kwa jibara!

Kwanahaan kǝ uudah ar yaa Israila. Iitǝr wa natǝrdal Daadamazhigǝl kǝ zarhaana, martǝrdan dlaɓ kǝ ndangǝraana, taatǝg kǝ langyi dǝ iitǝra, vǝltǝr kǝ adzahadzaha Muusa, martǝrdan kǝ ɗuula ɓa kwatǝnahǝra jiijiira, vǝltǝr baz langyiyaha.

Hulfaatǝr saral bamma daadiija daadiij kwa sǝrǝvtǝrsǝrǝg ba vaivaiya. Kǝristi dlaɓ tǝdvad ndzǝgana uuda dǝgshiga, sal ma kuɗigaatǝr nǝ iina. Aa galavgalǝg Daadamazhigǝl kwa kwara dǝgitah baɗǝm tangw damma zǝrazǝra. Aandz bandkwaha.
Walaa hǝtsalhǝtsǝg bi nǝ ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝl kǝ righǝg biya. Aɗaba ɗǝm bi yaa Isra'il ar vizhvizha Isra'ilah biya.
Dlaɓa ɗǝm bi lii ma kuɗiga Ibrahim ar vizhvizha zarha Ibrahim biya. Dlakulvakwaha, am Daadamazhigǝl taa kǝ Ibrahima, “Da kǝdlav tǝdvad Ishaku hulfagha.”
Ɗǝm bi zarhi yaha nǝ Ibrahim wa zarha Daadamazhigǝl biya, bamma zarhi tlavkǝna tǝdvad righa langyiya Daadamazhigǝla, iitǝr wa ɗahvǝtǝr dǝ zarha jiijiira.
Aɗaba kwan nǝ dǝgiti taghar Daadamazhigǝl kǝ Ibrahim ma sarta kwa tǝghara nǝ iin kǝ lanngyi taaki, “Akwama da ɓagaaɓag sarta, da yigaan Saratu kǝ zǝr lakwti ǝn da gwiiya sagauwa.”
Maay ba wah ndakwani, dzǝgaadzǝg Rifkatu kǝ ghwalah dǝ daadamiyam Ishaku.

Lakwti yav zarhǝn buwna, taghartag Daadamazhigǝl kǝ Rifkatu taakiya, “Maalǝn da ɓagarnǝs kwatǝnah kǝ kudǝrǝna.” Tagavar kwakyarvad daddakwa da kǝsavǝna, da kǝsav tǝdvad naaga Daadamazhigǝla. Tǝdvad tlǝrahaan biya, tǝdvad ɗahǝga Daadamazhigǝla. Dzǝghaar lakwti ɓa dǝgiti marawa ard ghwaɗ kǝ iitǝra.
Bandkwa vindavindan ma Kakkaɗa Daadamazhigǝl taakiya, “Waiyanantwaig kǝ Yakuba, ɗuwanantɗug kǝ Isuwa.”
Auci wa kiyam da tag nǝ miyami? Ɓagaa bi Daadamzhigǝl kǝ kalkal bi nii? Maaya! ǝndkwah biya!
Aɗaba taghartag Daadamazhigǝl kǝ Muus taakiya,

content.text: “Daddakwan da margar da nai kǝ zhuwadaala, iin wan da zhugardaala naiya,
daddakwan da margar da nai kǝ zanvaara, iin wan da zǝgarvaara naiya.”

content: Kwanǝnna, tsaghǝr tǝ naaga uud biya, bi dǝga ndzǝɗaan biya, amma aɗaba zhuwadaala Daadamazhigǝl kaltiya.
Am Kakkaɗa Daadamzhigǝl taa kǝ Firˈauna, “Nangkadalnǝg kǝ tlǝkǝs mbakyarvad ǝn marda kǝ ndzǝɗar tǝdvad kǝgha, dlaɓa tagvǝda ɗaagar ma duuni baɗǝmma.”
Tǝdvad kwah wa marǝg Daadamazhigǝl kǝ zhuwadaalaan kǝ daddakwa naag nǝ iin mararda kǝ zhuwadaalǝra, dlaɓa faraa kǝ dǝkdǝka ghǝr kǝ daddakwa naag nǝ iin faraa kǝ dǝkdǝka ghǝra.
Badzǝga ǝrviɗmahuɗa Daadamazhigǝla ard zhuwadaalaana
Pallǝraru da taguwatag taakiya, “Akwama bandkwah tsa, aujilbǝg kaci kǝ Daadamazhigǝl gwaastaan zhara kǝmiyam dǝ haipi? War wa da lǝwalǝg kǝ haiya dǝgiti naag Daadamazhigǝli?”
Kǝgh uuda, agha war nǝnng agha da ɓala agajaw dǝ Daadamazhigǝli? Dǝgiti ndǝravana, tagardatag kǝ daddakwa ndǝrgandǝrǝg taakiya, “Agha ndǝrkwi kiyavau ǝndkwana?”

Abi dadda ndǝra shak ɓagaan nǝ iin kǝ tlǝr dǝ luu bandkwa naag nǝ iin kǝ ɓagaana. Ɓagaɓag nǝ iin kǝ tlǝr dǝ ɗakwarga luu palla ndǝra kǝ kwatlǝrǝn kǝ shak mbakyarvad tlǝr kwa ndannga, kyalmahaan dlaɓa mbakyarvad tlǝr kwa maay ndanng biya.

Bandkwah tlǝra Daadamazhigǝla. Nahanahǝg mardan kǝ badzǝga ǝrviɗmahuɗaana, dlaɓa mardan kǝ ndzǝɗaan ba tǝ ɓalaɓala. Faafǝg Daadamazhigǝl kǝ ǝrviɗmahuɗ ba vaivai ɓǝshtǝrɓǝshig kǝ lii maa dlayatǝr badzǝga ǝrviɗmahuɗaana, lii fatǝra Daadamzhigǝl kiyava ghyǝhga.
Bandkwah dlaɓ wa naha nǝ iin martǝrdan kǝ ɗyakǝra ndanngǝran kǝ lii maratǝrda nǝ iin kǝ zhuwadaala, kwa ɓadlatǝrna nǝ iin ba zunngw kiyava ndanngǝraana.
Baz kǝmiyama, kǝmiyamǝn ɗahakiyamǝt Daadamazhigǝlǝna, Yahudah kalti biya, baz lii ar Yahudah biya.
Bandkwa tagavda ma kakkaɗa Huzaaya taakiya,

content.text: Ɗlaɓa lii ndza waiyantǝrǝt bi nai biya,
ǝn da ɗahtǝrɗahǝg dǝ lii, ‘Ən waitǝr naiya.’ ”
ba kalkala vakavaki tagavtǝra taakiya, ‘Am uudahar bi na,’ da ɗahǝvtǝr vakwah taakiya, ‘Ar zarha Daadamazhigǝl dǝ Shifǝga.’ ”

content: Tuwatuug tlayanng Ishaya kwakyardvad Israˈila taakiya,

content.text: “Aanji ar ba ɗyak nǝ uudaha Israˈila,
Aɗaba da tǝgaan Yaazhigǝl kǝ shariyan ma duuni baɗǝmma,
Bandkwa tagaa tlayanng Ishaya kǝ tlayanngǝraan ba wur taakiya,
“Maa ndza maay kwakyarvad Yaazhigǝla yaa Tlaamazhigǝlah wa
maa nakiyamdalnǝg nǝ uud band Gomora.”

content: Maira fadǝghǝra Israˈila

Au kaci wa kiyam da tag nǝ miyami? Lii ar Yahudah biya, kwa ghularva bi kǝ gata ndzǝgana kalkal tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝl biya, tlarkǝnatlǝga. Ndzǝgana kalkalǝn tlarkǝna nǝ iitǝrna, hulfa kwa tlǝvkǝna tǝdvad fadǝghǝra.
Amma Israˈilahi ghularvaghulǝg kǝ gata ɗuula ndzǝgan kalkal tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝl tǝdvad gata Adzahadzaha Muusa, tlarkǝna biya.
Aujilbǝg ǝndkwahi? Aɗaba gatar tǝ ɗuula fadǝghǝr biya, gatar tǝ ɗuula ɓa tlǝra. Kaa mbǝɗǝg kǝ iitǝr tǝ ɗuul da, “Akurǝn kwa fǝgaraa uud kǝ mbǝɗǝga.”
Bandkwa vindavindan ma Kakkaɗa Daadamazhigǝl taakiya,

content.text: akura kwa fǝgaraa uudah kǝ mbǝɗǝga.
